turns.question: How many monthly active customers did we have on 3 October 2026?
turns.answer: 10 engaged customers over the 28 days from 6 September to 3 October 2026 (customers with any site or CRM action in that window); this is the engaged-customer measure, not active customers, which count non-cancelled orders. Late: customer_actions.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
